verses.text_hr: A sada vam kažem, sinovi moji, ljubite pravednost i hodite po njoj; Jer su staze pravednosti dostojne prihvaćanja, Ali staze nepravednosti iznenada će biti uništene i nestati.

verses.text_en:
And to certain men of a generation shall the paths of violence and of death be revealed,
And they shall hold themselves afar from them,
And shall not follow them.
verses.text_hr: I određenim ljudima jedne generacije otkrit će se staze nasilja i smrti, i držat će se daleko od njih, i neće ih slijediti.

verses.text_en:
And now I say unto you the righteous:
Walk not in the paths of wickedness, nor on the paths of death,
And draw not nigh to them, lest ye be destroyed.
verses.text_hr: A sada govorim vama, pravednici: ne hodajte stazama zloće ni stazama smrti i ne približavajte im se, da ne budete uništeni.

verses.text_en:
But seek and choose for yourselves righteousness and an elect life,
And walk in the paths of peace,
And ye shall live and prosper.
verses.text_hr: Tražite i izaberite sebi pravednost i izabrani život; hodajte stazama mira pa ćete živjeti i napredovati.

verses.text_en:
And hold fast my words in the thoughts of your hearts,
And suffer them not to be effaced from your hearts;
For know that sinners will tempt men to =evilly-entreat= wisdom,
So that no place may be found for her,
And no manner of temptation may minish.
verses.text_hr: Čvrsto držite moje riječi u mislima svojega srca i ne dopustite da se iz njega izbrišu. Znajte da će grešnici navoditi ljude da se =opako ophode= prema mudrosti, tako da joj se ne nađe mjesta i da je nikakva kušnja ne umanji.

verses.text_en:
Woe to those who build unrighteousness and oppression,
And lay deceit as a foundation;
For they shall be suddenly overthrown,
And they shall have no peace.
verses.text_hr: Teško onima koji grade nepravdu i tlačenje te prijevaru polažu za temelj, jer će iznenada biti oboreni i neće imati mira.

verses.text_en:
Woe to those who build their houses with sin;
For from all their foundations shall they be overthrown,
And by the sword shall they fall.
[And those who acquire gold and silver in judgement suddenly shall perish.]
verses.text_hr: Teško onima koji svoje kuće grijehom grade; Jer iz svih će temelja biti srušeni, i od mača će pasti. [A oni koji steknu zlato i srebro na sudu iznenada će propasti.]

verses.text_en:
Woe to you, ye rich, for ye have trusted in your riches,
And from your riches shall ye depart,
Because ye have not remembered the Most High in the days of your riches.
verses.text_hr: Teško vama, bogataši, jer ste se pouzdali u svoje bogatstvo. Od svojega ćete bogatstva otići jer se niste spomenuli Svevišnjega u dane svojega obilja.

verses.text_en:
Ye have committed blasphemy and unrighteousness,
And have become ready for the day of slaughter,
And the day of darkness and the day of the great judgement.
verses.text_hr: Počinili ste bogohuljenje i nepravdu, i bili spremni za dan klanja, i dan tame i dan velikoga suda.

verses.text_en:
Thus I speak and declare unto you:
He who hath created you will overthrow you,
And for your fall there shall be no compassion,
And your Creator will rejoice at your destruction.
verses.text_hr: Ovako vam govorim i izjavljujem: Onaj koji vas je stvorio oborit će vas; pri vašem padu neće biti samilosti i vaš će se Stvoritelj radovati vašoj propasti.

verses.text_en:
And your righteous ones in those days shall be
A reproach to the sinners and the godless.
verses.text_hr: Vaši će pravednici u one dane biti prijekor grešnicima i bezbožnicima.
